links.outcome: Calibration error of model-reported confidence probabilities against expert-coder reference
links.effect: Against the ten-expert plurality, Jev's estimated calibration error was lower than both LLMs', clearly so only against Claude Opus 5.5. Comparisons depended on the reference, and a prespecified target was missed against single coders.

unlisted_practices: Typed decision model returning probabilities over predefined options for automated coding of counselling transcripts
Cost and latency comparison of a specialized model versus general-purpose LLMs

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking of a typed decision model (Jev 1.13) against LLMs and human expert coders for coding motivational interviewing transcripts, evaluating accuracy, calibration error, latency, and cost.
